results.title: Painkili
results.overview: Tale of Suku, who fakes insanity to escape the law. While faking insanity, he falls in love.

results.title: Hostile
results.overview: Four Soldiers are escorting an arrogant Lieutenant on a dangerous mission through the fields of Belgium. Can they complete their mission before the team falls apart? Or will the Lieutenant's actions cause the downfall of their company.

results.title: Happy Retirement!
results.overview: A hypnotic odyssey through the city of Toronto.

results.title: Passenger Jet
results.overview: Set in September of 1971, Lacy, a teenage hitchhiker, gets lost in a remote forest, where she spends many hallucinatory, surrealistic days and nights attempting to escape.

results.title: Deadlock
results.overview: The film takes place in Chernihiv in the first days of the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine. A group of people of different ages and social status find themselves in the basement of a high-rise building, where they are hiding from shelling. After the explosion, the entrance is blocked and everyone stays in the basement for 7 days, facing hunger and constant danger. Under the pressure of fear and uncertainty of who will find them — the Ukrainian army or the Russians — people are divided into warring groups.

results.title: The Black Panther Cubs: when the revolution doesn't come
results.original_title: The Black Panther Cubs: when the revolution doesn't come
results.overview: They are the children of the Black Panther party – the self-styled Panther cubs. Born into the 1970s revolutionary movement for Black equality and self-determination, they have lived in the shadows of a promised land that was never attained. We join them as they continue to wrestle, 50 years later, with the dichotomy of their extraordinary childhoods: the enormous pride and love it gave them as members of the Black Panther family, and the booming loss they endured – of parents, of security, and of the hope for radical change that did not materialise. That hope lives on in the cubs, and their reflections on America’s current crisis offers burning lessons for today.

results.title: Exposed
results.overview: A provocative thriller that plunges viewers into a livestream nightmare of betrayal, obsession, and secrets. As the cameras roll, the truth unravels, leaving no one untouched. Will Mia survive the night-or will her secrets be her undoing?

results.title: The Hike
results.overview: The Hike is a genre-bending mix of thriller, drama, and dark comedy that explores the complexities of male toxicity and friendship. When Mike and James set out on a hiking trip, lighthearted banter and candid conversations give way to rising tensions. As things spiral, the lines between camaraderie and conflict come to a head. Some paths should never be taken.

results.title: A Christmas Prayer
results.overview: Natalie is a children’s book illustrator struggling with creative burnout that finds unexpected inspiration when she comes across a little girl’s Christmas gift list. Unlike other children’s Christmas lists, Caroline writes her list of heartfelt prayers to Jesus, requesting blessings for her family, friends, and community – including one to ask that her recently widowed dad will find happiness again. Touched by Caroline’s list, Natalie begins to secretly fulfill each blessing. In turn, she is inspired to create a new character, Adeline the Angel, to illustrate the ways Jesus quietly works through everyday people to answer prayers with love and grace.

results.title: Maybe…
results.overview: An inventor who creates a time machine to correct his past mistakes encounters an unusual situation. One day, souls wanting to return to life begin to flock to his house...

results.title: Good Girl Bad Girl
results.overview: Saffron's one-night encounter with Ruby creates relationship chaos when her sometime girlfriend Heidi faces unexpected legal challenges

results.title: The Rolling Stones: Black and Blue
results.original_title: The Rolling Stones: Black and Blue
results.overview: The Rolling Stones' Black and Blue Super Deluxe box set, released on November 14, 2025, celebrates the 1976 album with a new stereo mix by Steven Wilson, previously unreleased outtakes, and a 1976 live concert in London. The 4-CD/1-Blu-ray set also includes a hardback book and replica memorabilia.

results.title: Und keiner geht hin
results.overview: A young theologian tries to stop her brother from going to Ukraine as a volunteer fighter – but his radical decision seems to call her own life plan into question and plunges her into an existential crisis.

results.title: Once upon a time there was a Mountain
results.overview: At the end of summer, a group of friends bid farewell to their childhood with a final football match and embark on a daring escapade, each about to embark on a different path in life.

results.title: March
results.overview: March wakes up to find New York City in its typical state of disarray. Forgetful and messy, and with an impending visit home for her mom’s birthday, she seeks an escape.

results.title: Elway
results.overview: Told in his own words, the definitive story of Denver Broncos quarterback John Elway goes deep on his NFL dreams, heartbreaks and Super Bowl redemption.
